data.revised_prompt: A single fictional Chinese schoolgirl avatar for a campus teacher-side student profile library, high-quality 3D chibi educational app style, refined sculpted modeling, soft material shading, bright warm brown eyes, studio softbox lighting, clearly identifiable as a student. Square 1:1 composition. Very tight head-focused portrait, front-facing or slight three-quarter view, entire hair silhouette visible, face and hair occupy 75% to 85% of the frame, only a very small amount of neck and shoulders visible at the bottom, definitely not a half-body portrait. The girl is about 8 to 14 years old, centered, with a confident lively generous smile. Hairstyle: high twin ponytails, thin bangs just above the eyebrows, two white circular hair ties, clearly distinguishable even at 48px. Bottom edge shows only a tiny bit of a white school lapel collar, no insignia, no text. Background must be fully filled edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner with a solid low-saturation jade green / jade cyan background, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no halo, no scenery, no scene elements. Clean, readable silhouette, bold shape, minimal detail, high contrast, icon-like clarity at small sizes. Avoid: half-body, upper body, full body, hands, props, teacher, adult, headset, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, top-of-head crop, hair crop, chin crop, tiny face, off-center subject, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circular background, avatar frame, ring, halo, scenery, text, letters, numbers, school emblem, logo, watermark, multiple characters, realistic photo, flat 2D illustration, baby proportions, dark tone, low resolution, distorted facial features.
